title: Carnitas Quesadilla
description: A twist on traditional quesadillas, filled with slow-cooked carnitas, served with a side of sliced radishes and warm tortillas.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and cook until caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pork shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chipotle peppers, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of water to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Shred the pork with two forks and stir in the sliced pastrami.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the quesadillas by spooning the carnitas mixture onto half of each tortilla and topping with cheese.
Fold the tortillas in half and cook in a large skillet over medium heat until the cheese is melted and the tortillas are crispy.
Serve hot with a side of sliced radishes and warm tortillas.
